name: Mudungkala / Murtankala (Tiwi)

domain_history.domain: primordial creator figure — emerges from the earth at southeast Melville Island carrying three infants, her passage forming the straits separating the Tiwi Islands from the mainland and each other, then covers the land with vegetation and animals

notes: Tiwi creation narrative, Palaneri (creation period). See trad_tiwi_pukumani for the contested oral-tradition dating of the flood/water motif in this narrative (Nunn and Reid 2016).
